motion.name: interactive-lift
motion.purpose: Purposeful button and card state feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action treatment for high-intent portfolio paths.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #a07a22; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; color: #050505; cursor: pointer; font: 600 12px Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; padding: 16px 40px; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -10px rgba(184,134,11,.4); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #231e1a; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A composed bilingual portfolio that makes premium web craft feel calm, legible, and materially considered.

rules.name: The Solid Voice Rule
rules.body: Text emphasis uses a single solid color, weight, or scale.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: A surface earns elevation through hierarchy or interaction.

dos: Do keep image composition stable during hover states.
donts: Don't use thick colored side stripes, bouncy motion, or image zoom hover effects.
